verdict.rationale: dlt itself is a Python ETL library with no embedded assistant, but the dltHub platform provides an 'AI Harness' (skills, rules, MCP servers) that lets a general-purpose coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) become an 'expert dlt pipeline developer,' and the Playground 'launches your coding agent ready to build your own source' as part of the product flow, effectively delegating pipeline-building tasks to an AI agent within the product experience. However, this is orchestration of external third-party agents rather than a proprietary built-in assistant, and there is no first-party dlt/dltHub chat-assistant UI shown. Missing for 10: evidence of a native, first-party in-product AI assistant (not just harness/skills for external agents), and independent/hands-on confirmation of the delegation workflow.
